notes.title: Fist Puncher Content Update and 50% Off Sale
notes.notes:
'Sup, ninjas? If you haven't visited the rough-and-tumble streets of Las Cruces yet, now is a great time to plan a trip. FIST PUNCHER is on sale all this week at 50% off ($4.99). It's old school brawling, just like your mama made it! Plus, we've updated the game with two new playable characters (Captain Falcon and Al Hazardous) and an all-new tough-as-nails "They Live" difficulty. Oh, and Steam Trading Cards, too.

What are you waiting for? Put those fists to good use and get with the punching!

Adult Swim Games
